Tropius

Grass Flying

Hoenn · Generation 3

Tropius is a Grass/Flying-type Fruit Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 100 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (99), with a base stat total of 460.
